Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fio && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keywords_init","line":4966,"var":"fio_keywords[2].replace","code":"sprintf(buf, \"%lu\", l); fio_keywords[2].replace = strdup(buf);","note":"Initializes the $ncpus replacement string used by keyword substitution."},
 {"step":2,"file":"init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":1850,"var":"line","code":"job file line contains description=$ncpus","note":"Attacker-controlled ini content supplies a description option value that references a reserved keyword."},
 {"step":3,"file":"options.c","function":"dup_and_sub_options","line":5142,"var":"opts_copy[i]","code":"opts_copy[i] = fio_option_dup_subs(opts[i]);","note":"The parser duplicates the option string so substitution can be performed on a heap copy."},
 {"step":4,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5092,"var":"opt","code":"while ((s = strstr(opt, kw->word)) != NULL)","note":"The replacement loop finds $ncpus inside the copied option string and prepares to rewrite it."},
 {"step":5,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5102,"var":"opt","code":"opt += strlen(kw->word) + olen;","note":"Advances opt past the keyword occurrence; when the keyword is not at the start, opt now points into the middle of the original heap buffer."},
 {"step":6,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5110,"var":"memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1)","code":"if (strlen(opt)) memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","note":"Uses the moved opt pointer to compute the copy length from the original buffer, creating an out-of-bounds read/write condition during keyword substitution."},
 {"step":7,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5195,"var":"opts_copy[i]","code":"parse_option(opts_copy[i], opts[i], fio_options, &o, &td->o, &td->opt_list);","note":"The malformed substituted option is then consumed by the option parser, reaching the sink where the heap overrun is observed by ASan."}
]
pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, separators=(',',':')))
print(pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').read_text())
PY
